# stackit_identity_group (Data Source)

Gets details about a STACKIT Identity group in an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stackit_identity_group" "group" {
  organization_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  group_id        = "yyyyyyyy-yyyy-yyyy-yyyy-yyyyyyyyyyyy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The internal UUID of the group to look up.
- `organization_id` (String) STACKIT Organization ID to which the group is associated.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the group's purpose.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the group.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as "`organization_id`,`group_id`".
